title: Possible sandwich attack when buying a coin
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  When buying a coin through `buy()` in GroupcoinFactory.sol, the buyer will attach some `msg.value` to the function in order to buy a certain number of coins. In `buy()`, there is no slippage protection, so a malicious user can buy  For example,  - Alice wants to buy 1000 Acoin. She is the first buyer and she calculates that she needs about 3434501 wei of ETH to buy (amount calculated from the `getPrice()` function.
